description: This PHP source file defines the SkillDao class, which manages database operations related to 'Skill' entities. It includes methods for saving, fetching by ID, deleting, and searching skills, utilizing Doctrine ORM components. The class extends a base DAO class and interacts with repositories and query builders to perform CRUD operations and complex searches.

classes.name: SkillDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling database operations related to 'Skill' entities, including CRUD and search functionalities.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Persists a Skill entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill entity by its ID; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingSkillIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing skills from a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes skills corresponding to given IDs. Returns number of deleted records.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Performs a search for skills based on filter parameters, returning matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchSkillPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator object for skill search results, applying filters and sorting.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of skills matching the search criteria.
